items.title: God Will Supply All Your Needs
items.summary: If we live by faith in God’s promise of future grace, it will be very hard for anxiety to survive.

items.title: 7 Reasons Not to Worry, Part 3
items.summary: God will see to it that you are not tested in any given day more than you can bear.

items.title: 7 Reasons Not to Worry, Part 2
items.summary: God will certainly take his energy and creative skill, and use it to care for his children since they will live forever.

items.title: 7 Reasons Not to Worry, Part 1
items.summary: Jesus helps us to fight the good fight against unbelief and to be free from anxiety.

items.title: How to Fight Anxiety
items.summary: The way you fight the good fight for faith is by meditating on God’s assurances of future grace and by asking for the help of his Spirit.

items.title: Grace Must Be Free
items.summary: If you treated your salvation no longer as a gift, but as a purchase, God would no longer be the free benefactor.

items.title: How to Repay God
items.summary: You can’t give anything to God or do anything for God that he hasn’t first given to you and done for you.

items.title: The Joy That Sustained Jesus
items.summary: Jesus endured unspeakable agony at the cross. Pastor John marvels at the force of his love sustained by expectant joy.

items.title: The Barrier to Doctrinal Maturity
items.summary: Is the Bible accessible only to readers with a high IQ? Pastor John reframes biblical maturity as a moral issue centered on our obedience, not our intellect.

items.title: Daily Vigilance for Lifelong Productivity
items.summary: Daily productivity requires often elusive focus and grit. Pastor John offers ten charges to live each day to the glory of God.

items.title: Why Did Jesus Call Her a Dog?
items.summary: Did Jesus demean the Canaanite woman he called a dog? Pastor John explains how Jesus’s test revealed her great faith — and her adoption as one of God’s own.

items.title: When Walking Away Feels Good
items.summary: Why should we follow Jesus when life seems easier without him? Pastor John responds to a man questioning the cost of daily obedience.

items.title: How a Crushed Faith Comes Home
items.summary: Deep suffering can drive us away from true hope and comfort. But our Father waits to gather us back to himself.

items.title: House of God (Part 2)
items.summary: One of the biggest questions the Bible answers is, “If human beings have been separated from God, how can we be in his presence again?” The good news is this: from the days of Adam and Eve to our own lives today, God has been working out a plan that allows us to dwell with him once again. The apostle Paul describes…

items.title: House of God (Part 1)
items.summary: Being part of a church doesn’t mean we’re part of an audience. Rather, each of us is a building block that plays a crucial part in making up the whole. The apostle Paul explains this when he says we as Christians are stones that build a holy temple—stones that must enjoy unity, connection, and intimacy if we are to…

items.title: Brought Near (Part 2)
items.summary: When we consider what it means to be “close to God,” it’s likely we think of the religious as near to him and non-churchgoers as far away. But Paul tells us that no matter how close we seem, we are all equally estranged from God until we call Christ our Savior. As the Book of Ephesians points out, the real question…

items.title: Abiding in the Lord
items.summary: The abiding life isn’t about impressing God—it’s about surrendering all to Him. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

items.title: Failure in Faith
items.summary: Failure can be the turning point where we set aside our pride and follow God wholeheartedly. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

items.title: Confidence in Prayer
items.summary: The Lord calls us to pray according to His will, and He gives us His Spirit for guidance. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

items.title: Freedom in Christ
items.summary: Confession is the door that leads to experiencing God’s grace, healing, and freedom. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

items.title: Avoiding Enslavement
items.summary: Though sin may beckon, God has equipped us with the power to resist temptation. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

items.title: What's Required for Salvation?
items.summary: The entire Trinity works in our salvation, giving us the comfort of complete assurance. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

items.title: God Honors Our Devotion to Him
items.summary: Being faithful to the Lord may put us at odds with the world, but the reward of His delight is always worth it. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

items.title: Salvation from Sin (2 Kings 14:27)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on 2 Kings 14:27, David Platt shows how Jesus’ death for our sins brings forgiveness and reconciliation with God. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Called to Faith and Obedience (2 Kings 13:18–19)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on 2 Kings 13:18–19, David Platt urges us to trust God completely and follow his commands without holding back. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Faith Across Generations (2 Kings 11:1)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on 2 Kings 11:1, David Platt discusses the significant impact families have on passing down faith. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Wiping Out Idolatry (2 Kings 10:27)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on 2 Kings 10:27, David Platt urges believers to confront and remove idolatry from their hearts. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Trusting God's Sovereignty (2 Kings 9:3)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on 2 Kings 9:3, David Platt reflects on God’s sovereign control over history and the fulfillment of his promises. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Unfailing Grace (2 Kings 8:19)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on 2 Kings 8:19, David Platt praises God for his faithfulness despite our unfaithfulness. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Feasting on God's Word (2 Kings 7:9)
items.summary: In this episode of Pray the Word on 2 Kings 7:9, David Platt urges Christians to rejoice in God’s grace and to share the gospel. Explore more content from Radical.

items.title: Why Is God Jealous?
items.summary: God’s jealousy is not sinful, insecure, or possessive. It is His holy zeal for His glory and His covenant relationship with His people. In this episode, Costi Hinn explains what it means for God to be El Qanna, the jealous God, and why He refuses to share the worship that belongs exclusively to Him.

items.title: God Is Stronger Than Your Circumstances
items.summary: In this episode, Costi Hinn explores El Gibbor, the Mighty God, and what this name reveals about the strength, sovereignty, and victory of God. When life feels bigger than you, remember: you don’t have to be strong enough. Your God is.

items.title: The God Who Sees You
items.summary: In this episode, Costi Hinn explores the name El Roi—the God who sees me. Through the story of Hagar, we’re reminded that God sees us in our pain, our struggles, and the moments when everyone else overlooks us. But His seeing also means He sees our sin, our motives, and our private lives. El Roi brings both comfort…

items.title: When God Does the Impossible
items.summary: In this episode, Costi Hinn continues the Names of God series by exploring El Shaddai—God Almighty. Through the story of Abraham, we see that our limitations are never a limitation for God. When our strength runs out, His resources never do.

items.title: The First Name of God
items.summary: In this episode, Costi Hinn kicks off a new series on the names of God by exploring Elohim—the first name of God revealed in Scripture. Elohim reveals God as Creator, sovereign, powerful, and completely self-sufficient, calling us to worship, trust, and rest in Him.
